cc:Work.dc:title: Model Performance
cc:Work.dc:description: Win rate and mean terminal opponent HP depletion for the same30battles per native system. Opus20/30and89.58%HP; Carbon17/30and84.47%; Astra15/30and81.80%; Neon15/30and81.49%; Sol14/30and81.76%; Flash5/30and70.86%. HP depletion weights each of Cynthia's six original Pokémon equally. Raw component metrics are retained separately from the composite score.
